value.rationale: The natural lower-density problem for antipalindromic integer quotient complements is explicitly studied in Bai et al. The exact infinite valuation-indexed exclusion family raises the published bound from 1/60 to >0.08816, a substantive factor-of-five quantitative improvement. Exact asymptotic of the explicit subset is motivated by the ratio-set density problem, not by an arbitrary selected interval.
